title: Find the First Match
subtitle: A Python field guide to binary search boundaries
purpose: Teach readers to maintain a half-open search interval and reason about duplicates.
audience: Students who can read Python loops

criteria: Preserve all listing lines, indentation, and characters.
Keep the duplicate and missing-target outcomes distinct.

blocks.text: A sorted list may have several copies of a value. To find the first copy, search for the first index with a value greater than or equal to the target.

steps.label: Probe index 2
steps.detail: Value 4 can be the answer, so move the right boundary to 2.

steps.label: Probe index 1
steps.detail: Value 4 can still be the answer, so move the right boundary to 1.

steps.label: Probe index 0
steps.detail: Value 2 is too small. Move the left boundary to 1 and return 1.

blocks.title: Two boundaries, one rule
blocks.text: The possible answer lies between left and right, inclusive. Only the probes are restricted to the half-open interval [left, right).

blocks.caption: Lower bound, equal range, and four checks

blocks.title: Verify a missing value
steps: Record each probed index and the next interval.
Explain why both interval endpoints are 4.
blocks.check: An empty interval at index 4 identifies the insertion point.
